stem.text: Four beams of the same length each have three forces acting on them.
Which beam has both zero resultant force and zero resultant torque acting?

A.alt: Horizontal beam with three vertical forces and printed force and distance labels.

B.alt: Horizontal beam with three vertical forces and printed force and distance labels.

C.alt: Horizontal beam with three vertical forces and printed force and distance labels.

D.alt: Horizontal beam with three vertical forces and printed force and distance labels.
